title: Zombie Breach in Rainy Office
description: A dimly lit abandoned office with a wooden desk holding a lit lamp, coffee cup, radio and tools. Rain streaks down the windows at night. A large section of the wall has been torn open revealing a blood-red corridor where three zombies shamble forward, one wielding an axe.
prompt: A decaying office interior at night during heavy rain, water streaks on tall windows. A wooden desk in the foreground holds a lit desk lamp, coffee cup, old radio and tools. A massive jagged hole in the wall reveals a blood-soaked hallway lit by red emergency lights where three grotesque zombies are breaking through, one raising an axe, another crawling over debris, cinematic horror atmosphere, detailed textures, moody lighting
